connector.name: Craft by illumora.io
connector.registryDescription: Illumora Craft - evidence-augmented prompt compile for agents via remote MCP (OAuth) or local stdio.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.illumora.io over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.illumora, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
